name: 78596 · Weslaco, TX
findings: ZIP 78596 (Weslaco) has 86 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78596 (Weslaco) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
62% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 78596 (Weslaco) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65% of the typical level).

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
